documentSuppression.observed: No offer while a document is open, matching SyncHintContext document suppression.

confirmed: Default native launch and actual 150% text setting; no diagnostic or shortened timing flags.
Document reading suppresses offers after more than 180 seconds without harness-issued input.
Reader offer appears after a real 183.07-second no-input wait; capture at 193.44 seconds. This is not an exact firing-frame measurement.
The 150% header offer is visually disjoint from title/subtitle and does not steal existing keyboard focus.
Tab preserves the visible offer; Shift+Tab reaches the new dismiss button.
Enter dismisses the offer while retaining the reader tool and displayed progress.
The offer reappears after the unchanged 180-second dismissal cooldown; second observation 198 seconds after dismissal completion.
A real pointer click on the offered View help button opens only the free-hint menu; no hint body is revealed.
Escape closes the help overlay and returns to the same reader context.
automationBoundaries: The initial direct-binary launch showed a black inactive window until explicit macOS activation/AXRaise. Window creation alone was not counted as readiness.
Two Orca coordinate-click attempts were rejected as window_not_focused despite restore/AX focus observations; neither was counted as delivered input.
Successful inputs used explicit OS activation, a same-call CGWindow topmost PID/window assertion, and cliclick. Read-only native screenshots were then captured.

The Enter-dismiss macro clicked empty header space first, which deselected the control visually. Its after-frame proves tool retention, not visual focus restoration; focused restoration is covered by the PlayMode regression.
Native Escape proof closes the help overlay. Offered-toast Escape/controller-B priority and session-only dismissal counts are covered by PlayMode, not by a physical controller claim.
Orca returned either 1280x864 or 1088x734 window captures; this receipt records actual returned dimensions, not a raw-GPU/lossless capture claim.
